desc:
⚽ Welcome to UEFA Playmakers Academy! 🐾

Build your own team of football Playmakers and lead them to glory! 🌟

🥚 Hatch - Open eggs to discover Playmakers of every look and rarity ✨
🏃 Train - Level up goalkeeping, passing, dribbling & striking ⚽
🏟️ Compete - Play 5-a-side matches and climb the leagues 🏅
🔄 Swap - Sub in fresh Playmakers when your team gets tired
🔋 Recharge - Rest and care for tired Playmakers, or give them a Golden Banana! 🍌
🏠 Decorate - Unlock furniture and colours for the Playmakers House
🏆 Earn - Collect Gold to hatch eggs and boost team power 💪
📖 Collect - Fill your collection book with every Playmaker
🌍 Explore - Unlock new worlds and seasonal surprises!
📋 Quest - Complete quests to unlock rewards and new challenges
🎁 Win - Unlock free, limited-edition UGC items before they're gone!
🤝 Invite - Bring friends to the Academy and earn rewards

How many Playmakers can you collect? 💛 Start your academy today! 🚀
